blockingFindings.title: Explicit phase behavior does not verify recovery suppression
blockingFindings.target: specs/333-failure-atomic-gate/tests/gate-failure-atomicity.test.js: R6 direct exports preserve explicit and inferred phase behavior
blockingFindings.rationale: This acceptance requirement has no corresponding coverage for the no-inferred-recovery half of the behavior; an implementation could still recover stale steps under explicit `--phase` and pass these tests.
blockingFindings.issue: R6 requires explicit `--phase` to select the supplied phase without inferred recovery, but the test only asserts `resolveEffectiveGatePhase({ phase: "spec" }) === "spec"`. It does not exercise the transition/recovery path or assert that stale inferred steps are not reported or committed when an explicit phase is supplied.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion or test that runs the explicit-phase path against a state with stale gates and verifies no inferred stale-step recovery is produced or committed.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This acceptance requirement has no corresponding coverage for the no-inferred-recovery half of the behavior; an implementation could still recover stale steps under explicit `--phase` and pass these tests.

blockingFindings.title: FAIL/retry active-step routing is not covered
blockingFindings.target: specs/333-failure-atomic-gate/tests/gate-failure-atomicity.test.js: R6 provider, lifecycle, retry, artifact, and routing parity is exercised directly
blockingFindings.rationale: A required routing behavior could regress without detection because only the PASS side of the acceptance requirement is tested.
blockingFindings.issue: R6 requires PASS to advance to the configured next step while FAIL/retry retains its configured active-step route. The test asserts only the PASS route via `deriveNextAction(...)` returning `retro`; it does not assert the FAIL/retry route retention behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local test assertion covering the FAIL/retry route and verifying it retains the configured active step.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A required routing behavior could regress without detection because only the PASS side of the acceptance requirement is tested.

blockingFindings.title: Phase source artifact path parity is not covered
blockingFindings.target: specs/333-failure-atomic-gate/tests/gate-failure-atomicity.test.js: R6 provider, lifecycle, retry, artifact, and routing parity is exercised directly
blockingFindings.rationale: The coverage artifact marks R6 covered, but one explicit artifact-path requirement is missing from the executable tests.
blockingFindings.issue: R6 requires existing phase source/result artifact paths to remain unchanged. The tests verify `impl-gate-result.json`, but they do not verify the source artifact path on the successful parity path.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion that the integration gate source artifact path remains `impl-gate-source.json` in the relevant path-writing behavior.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The coverage artifact marks R6 covered, but one explicit artifact-path requirement is missing from the executable tests.
